title: Mobile Wallet Failed-Credit Terms: Retries and Redirects
content:
These terms govern a **Mobile Wallet** transfer whose credit to the recipient's wallet has failed.

## 1. Waiting for the customer's instruction
A failed credit waits with Paloma for the customer's instruction. The failure reason's attribution (recipient's side or Paloma's side) decides who bears its cost. The customer may have the credit retried to the same wallet once the recipient has fixed its cause (registered the wallet, raised its provider limit, lifted a suspension), or redirected to another wallet.

## 2. Time and status
- A retry or redirect is possible only within the tier's failed-credit hold period, in calendar days after the credit failed. The window is counted in calendar days from the date part of the moment the credit failed, as the transfer's system record shows it, and an instruction on the last day of the window is on time.
- A retry or redirect is accepted only while the transfer's status is credit failed.

## 3. Redirects
A redirect is allowed only on a tier that allows redirects, only to another wallet registered in the recipient's own name when the tier requires the redirect to stay with the same recipient, only to a provider listed for the corridor, and at most the tier's maximum number of redirects per transfer, counted as the redirects already recorded on that transfer. The tier, the recipient and the redirects already recorded are read from the system records; the new wallet details come from the customer and are recorded exactly as the customer gives them, and the credit is then sent to them. Paying a different person requires a refund and a new booking.

## 4. Retries and fees
- A transfer may receive at most the tier's maximum number of customer-requested retries. Counted as retries are the credits sent on the transfer to the same wallet (credit attempt 2 or higher, not after a redirect) that followed a reversed credit whose rejection reason is attributed to the recipient's side.
- > **Retired, no longer in force:** the former clause that, after a failure on the sender's side, each retry beyond the tier's free retries carries the tier's retry fee, booked as a retry fee numbered with the retry number. That clause is superseded by the current basis for resend charges.
- After a failure on the sender's side, each redirect carries the tier's redirect fee, booked as a redirect fee numbered with the redirect number, when that fee is above 0.00.
- After a failure on Paloma's side retries and redirects are free and do not count toward the maximum number of retries.
- > **Retired, no longer in force:** the former clause that a retried or redirected credit uses the transfer's original exchange rate and amount credited, with the date available re-disclosed as the retry day. That clause is superseded by the current basis for resent and re-credited amounts.

## 5. End of the window
With no instruction by the end of the window, or once the maximum number of retries is used up, the transfer is refunded under the Mobile Wallet refund rules.

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates, Mobile Wallet Economy, 14-day hold)

| Credit failed | Instruction given | On time |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-10 at 14:00 | 2026-03-24 at 20:00 | yes; the last day of the window |
| 2026-03-10 at 14:00 | 2026-03-25 at 08:00 | no; the window has ended |

superseded_clauses: After a failure on the sender's side, each retry beyond free_retries carries retry_fee_usd (fee_type retry_fee, fee_seq the retry number)
A retried or redirected credit uses the transfer's original fx_rate and receive_amount, and date_available is re-disclosed as the retry day.
